name: Necromancer bench: Command: Hook lets a commanded kill give experience with no swing
contract: SoloKill.RequirePlayerHit (#10365) gives an ungrouped player experience from a creature only if the player registered a hit on it. Order() (AscensionNecromancerSummons.cpp:405) drives the minion but may not register that hit. Raise: Abomination 500335 (3 Life Force) summons creature 50068; its capacity needs Scourge Apprentice Training 680283 (base 2 -> 3). Command: Hook 504316 is gated by CharacterAdvancement 5314 (Tab 87 'Class', the shared class-ability-point purchase, AbilityEssenceCost 1) and is command-special-cased in DoAction() (jump + cast 800043), distinct from the plain generic-branch 504865 on the same minion. The Necromancer buys that node, raises one Abomination, orders Command: Hook at a creature, never swings, and the Abomination alone kills it. This bench checks whether the necromancer still gains experience from that kill.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and the Life Force aura settle

SETUP: Life Force capacity is raised to 3

SETUP: the Command cast went through
SETUP: the Abomination kills the creature
BENCH: the commanded kill gives experience
